properties.decision:
RECORDED AS BRAINSTORMING, NOT AS A PROPOSAL. Anthony, 2026-09-16, in his words: *"again exploring the concept of partnering with other MCPs, I was thinking about building an MCP around (pip install xrt) and then being able to design beamlines and or experiments at NSLS-II."* His day job is the NSLS-II bluesky stack; this is the domain he can measure the tool against himself.

═══ WHAT xrt IS (PyPI, read 2026-09-16) ═══
XRayTracer 1.6.2 (Feb 2026), MIT, Klementiev & Chernikov. Ray tracing plus wave propagation (Kirchhoff) in the x-ray regime; sources: bending magnet, wiggler, undulator, elliptic undulator; elements: mirrors, crystals in dynamical diffraction, gratings, zone plates, multilayers; materials with several scattering-factor tabulations; non-sequential optics; OpenCL for undulator and wave calculations. A beamline is a PYTHON SCRIPT instantiating components — or an XML recipe from the xrtQook GUI that generates the script. xrtGlow is an OpenGL 3D view. No MCP server exists for it that this session found (unchecked beyond PyPI).

⭐ THE SAME SHAPE AS IfcMCP, IN THE DOMAIN HE OWNS. An IFC model is to a building what an xrt script is to a beamline: the artifact in the tool of the trade's own form, with a deterministic engine behind it. Pairing is skill-shaped and lives at the agent (dec:github-mcp-tandem); reflow2 never learns what an undulator is. The difference from IfcMCP: nobody has built the MCP, so this is "build the door", and the door is small — xrt is a Python library with a script as its artifact, so the server is a thin wrapper: load/define a beamline, run, return the quantities and the plots.

═══ WHERE IT PAYS, strongest first ═══
(1) ⭐ THE REQUIREMENT IS CHECKED BY THE ENGINE. "≥ 10¹² ph/s at the sample in a 5 µm spot at 8 keV" is a Requirement with a Constraint; xrt computes flux, spot and bandwidth from the source and optics; the number lands as COMPUTED (by xrt, from the script, at a time) against the constraint — the provenance requirement (`req:a-quantity-carries-how-it-was-obtained-and-an-unsourced-one-is-reported`) exercised on the first day, and a check with an executable form (the script) instead of the 265-of-270 with none.
(2) ⭐ IMPACT RIPPLES THROUGH PHYSICS. Move a mirror, change a crystal, raise the energy range: propagate_change says which requirements the change touches, the re-run says which still hold. That is the four-transition thesis in reflow2's vision.md, on a system where the transitions are expensive in the real world (a monochromator is not re-cut on a whim).
(3) THE ARTIFACT STANDARD IS ALREADY THE SCRIPT. The beamline definition is Python the design can register, checksum and diff; the standard question today's build asks has a clean answer ("an xrt script; checker: run it").
(4) EXPERIMENT DESIGN IS A DIFFERENT QUESTION, and it should be said so it is not lost: designing an EXPERIMENT at NSLS-II is bluesky plans over ophyd devices through the queue server — the artifact is a plan, the checker is a dry-run or a simulated RunEngine, and the tool of the trade is bluesky, not xrt. Same pairing shape, different server; his /log-issue observation about the queue service is already in the design. Recorded here as a sibling to raise separately, not folded in.

═══ THE HONEST COUNTERS ═══
· ⭐ A RAY TRACE IS PROOF AGAINST A MODEL, NOT AGAINST THE BEAMLINE (cap:evidence-fidelity is built for exactly this). Mirror figure error, thermal load, alignment and vibration are why commissioned flux differs from traced flux; xrt's number must land as model-fidelity evidence and stay distinguishable from a measurement at the beamline, or the pairing manufactures the confident wrong number it was meant to prevent.
· The other tool of the trade at synchrotrons is SHADOW/OASYS, and NSLS-II's own optics group has its habits; a pairing that names xrt as THE standard is a choice the org template question (dec:idea-an-org-template-carries-the-approved-references-a-design-must-use) says belongs to the organisation.
· Run time: an undulator source plus wave propagation is minutes to hours, GPU-dependent; a checker that takes an hour is not a gate, it is a scheduled Verification with a `last_run_at`.
· Who maintains the MCP: a thin wrapper over a library that moves is a maintenance promise; the IfcMCP lesson today was that even the project's own server had an install trap.

═══ THE OPTIONS, none chosen ═══
A. ⭐ THE THIN WRAPPER, ON ONE REAL BEAMLINE: an MCP exposing `beamline_load` (a script or xrtQook XML), `beamline_run` (rays and/or wave, energy range, seed), `beamline_quantities` (flux, spot, bandwidth, at a named plane), `beamline_plot` (xrt's own figures as PNG), `beamline_elements` (the components, read back). Pair it with reflow2 through a served skill that says: the requirement and its constraint come from the graph; the run is the Verification's executable form; the quantities land as computed against the constraint; the script is the registered artifact. Try it on one NSLS-II beamline he knows, against its commissioned numbers — the fidelity gap is then MEASURED.
B. DESIGN THE BEAMLINE IN THE GRAPH FIRST, TRACE LATER — genesis a beamline (source, optics, endstation as components; interfaces as the beam at each plane; requirements as flux/spot/resolution) with no simulator, to see what reflow2 alone catches. Cheap and immediate; tells you what the simulator adds.
C. EXPERIMENT DESIGN FIRST (bluesky) — closer to his daily work and to the queue-service observation; the checker is a dry-run RunEngine. Different server, same skill shape.
D. NOTHING — treat xrt as an artifact reflow2 registers and a check the agent runs by hand. ⚠️ Counter: by hand is exactly where the number gets typed rather than computed.

═══ THE GENERAL SHAPE, which is the reason to record this beside IfcMCP ═══
Three pairings in one day (GitHub, IFC, xrt) draw the same figure: reflow2 holds intent, structure, constraints and the thread; the domain's own tool holds the artifact and the engine; a served skill joins them; quantities flow back as COMPUTED or MEASURED with their source; the tool's checker is the Verification's executable form. If that figure holds for a third domain it is a product shape, not a coincidence — and it is what "reflow2 for any domain" was always going to have to mean, because reflow2 cannot know physics and must not pretend to.
properties.name: OPEN — build an MCP around xrt (pip install xrt: ray tracing and wave propagation for synchrotron sources and beamlines, MIT) so a beamline or experiment design at NSLS-II is RAY-TRACED against its requirements — flux, spot, resolution computed by the tool, not asserted by the agent — and is that the general shape for pairing reflow2 with a domain simulator?
properties.rationale: Captured under the brainstorm skill, nothing promoted. Recorded as its own question rather than appended to the CAD-pairing idea because the tool, the domain and the person who can measure it are different, and because this one has no existing server — it is "build the door". The counter that carries the most weight is fidelity: the design already has vocabulary for proof-against-a-model versus proof-against-reality, and a simulator pairing is where that vocabulary earns its keep or gets skipped. Experiment design (bluesky) is named as a sibling on purpose, so a later session does not read "beamlines and/or experiments" as one thing.
